title: The Salvage Pilot's Last Haul
logline: An aging salvage pilot hires an armed outsider to protect her sixty-year-old tug from demolition contractors who want to scrap her hull and seize its rare thorium reactor core.

roles.description: A sixty-year veteran of asteroid belt salvage; half-deaf, stubborn, clinging to the only ship she has ever owned.
Represents the scrap yard consortium; impatient, eager to melt down obsolete private hulls to meet steel recycling quotas.
A heavy scrapper vessel fitted with industrial cutting lasers and plasma torches.
The guild of orbital metal workers seeking to protect veteran members from forced vessel retirement.
The industrial recycling trust holding sovereign scrapping charters over old hulls.
A crowded floating yard where decommissioned freighters are stripped for re-smelting.
An abandoned deep-space reactor testing rig drifting in an asteroid shadow.
The certified intake station where extracted reactor elements are weighed and bought.

public_situation: {role:salvage_consortium} issues a mandatory scuttle order for ships over fifty standard years old, targeting {role:veteran_scrapper}'s vintage tug.
private_truth: {role:veteran_scrapper} secretly recovered an intact antique thorium fuel core from {role:thorium_reef} and welded it into her tug's engine cradle to power life-support without paying station utility tariffs.

beats.public_change: Scrap yard inspectors attach repossession beacons to outer berths, citing structural fatigue violations on antique hulls.

missions.reason: She needs an outside pilot to mine and deliver dense thorium ore to her berth to replenish coolant shielding around the vintage reactor before inspectors board.
missions.private_fact: Her ship's original lead baffle cracked three weeks ago and she has been cooling the reactor by hand.

beats.public_change: {role:salvage_consortium} declares an administrative lien on the veteran tug, dispatching cutters to tow the ship to the breakers.

missions.reason: She needs a pilot to scan the old testing rig and retrieve the original de-licensing certificate proving her vintage tug was granted an indefinite operating waiver.
missions.private_fact: The consortium deleted the original waiver from the central registry to justify condemning her ship.

beats.public_change: {role:demolition_cutter} powers up industrial cutting lasers and moves toward {role:scrappers_berth} with armed escorts.

missions.reason: She needs the demolition cutter disabled before its cutting torches slice through her tug's mooring pylons.
missions.private_fact: The demolition factor hails mid-fight offering forty thousand credits and a modern shuttle if the pilot stands aside while they seize the thorium core.

beats.public_change: Breakers yard sirens sound as the magistrate's administrative tribunal convenes at {role:assay_dock}.

missions.reason: She asks the pilot to courier the certified waiver and reactor stability assay to the magistrate's dock before the final scuttle hearing.
missions.private_fact: She intends to name the pilot in her ship's will as sole heir to the vessel once she can no longer fly.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the waiver and drives off the demolition cutter.
resolutions.summary: The magistrate grants {role:veteran_scrapper} a lifetime exemption for her tug. {role:scrappers_union} celebrates, and the consortium is forced to back down.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot fought off scrap yard cutters and delivered ancient charter papers to save an old woman's sixty-year-old tug.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot accepts the demolition factor's payout.
resolutions.summary: {role:salvage_consortium} extracts the rare thorium core and scraps the vintage tug. {role:veteran_scrapper} is relegated to a station bunkhouse, broken by the loss of her ship.

resolutions.reached_by: Inspection fails or the hearing deadline expires without documentation.
resolutions.summary: Consortium plasma torches slice the vintage tug into furnace feedstock. {role:veteran_scrapper} is forcibly retired, and the rare thorium core is claimed by the scrap yard.

loose_threads.detail: The vintage reactor housing bears an unlisted government testing serial matching an experimental division from forty years ago.
The scrap yard posted an advance allocation for forty tons of vintage rolled armor plate a week before the condemnation order.
The demolition cutter carries an altered hull registration covering the callsign of a bankrupt cargo line.

radio_hooks: Salvage consortium reaffirms commitment to retiring structurally obsolete spaceframes.
Scrappers union holds demonstration against compulsory scrapping of independent tugs.
Assay office reports volatile demand fluctuations for certified reactor-grade thorium.

voice_direction.veteran_scrapper: Gruff, loud, and gravel-voiced. Cuts through polite inquiries with blunt engineering obscenities and speaks of her ship like an aging sibling.
voice_direction.demolition_factor: Smooth, impatient, and bureaucratic. Quotes scrap weight formulas and municipal liability codes to justify destroying independent livelihoods.
